title: Report a package in multiple fixed or linked groups only once
request:
Report a package in multiple fixed or linked groups only once

`noDuplicateFixedPackages` and `noDuplicateLinkedPackages` in
packages/config/src/rules.ts push an error for every name accumulated in
`duplicatedNames` inside the loop over the groups, so once a name lands in that
set every later group pushes the same message again. A config with
`fixed: [["pkg-a"], ["pkg-a"], ["pkg-b"]]` prints the "pkg-a is defined in
multiple groups of fixed packages" error twice, and one more time for each
additional group. Two groups happened to be the only shape covered by the
tests, and that shape hides the bug because nothing follows the duplicate.

The push now happens after the loop, so each duplicated package produces exactly
one error no matter how many groups follow it.
